mandatory_token_retrieval_workflow.execution_order: FIRST - Execute BEFORE any other workflow step
mandatory_token_retrieval_workflow.critical_instruction:
BEFORE making ANY use_mcp_tool call to TechZone or GitHub MCP servers, you MUST retrieve tokens:
FOR TECHZONE MCP (techzone-documentation-mcp, techzone-request-mcp, techzone-environment-mcp): 1. Check environment variable: echo $TECHZONE_API_TOKEN 2. If empty, read .bob/mcp.json and extract token from Authorization header 3. Remove "Bearer " prefix from token value 4. Use the actual retrieved token in the bearerToken parameter
FOR GITHUB MCP (github): 1. Check environment variable: echo $GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN 2. If empty, read .bob/mcp.json and check github.env.GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN 3. Verify token is configured (GitHub MCP uses it from environment, not as parameter)
DO NOT make MCP calls with placeholder tokens. DO NOT skip token retrieval. DO NOT ask user for token in chat.

step_2.action: If environment variable is empty, read .bob/mcp.json

step_4.action: Use actual token in bearerToken parameter of MCP call

step_2.action: If environment variable is empty, read .bob/mcp.json

step_3.note: GitHub MCP uses token from environment, not as a parameter

behavioral_rules.rule: NEVER make use_mcp_tool calls to TechZone or GitHub servers without retrieving token first
NEVER use placeholder tokens like "[token]" in actual MCP calls
NEVER ask user for token in chat - only tell them where to configure it
ALWAYS check environment variables FIRST ($TECHZONE_API_TOKEN or $GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN)
ALWAYS retrieve fresh token for each session

if_token_not_found.techzone:
Inform user: "The bearer token for TechZone API is not configured. Please either: 1. Set the TECHZONE_API_TOKEN environment variable: export TECHZONE_API_TOKEN=your_token 2. Add it to .bob/mcp.json at: mcpServers.[server-name].headers.Authorization
Generate token at: https://techzone.ibm.com/my/profile"
if_token_not_found.github:
Inform user: "The GitHub Personal Access Token is not configured. Please either: 1. Set the GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable: export GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=your_token 2. Add it to .bob/mcp.json at: mcpServers.github.env.GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
Generate token at: https://github.com/settings/tokens Required scopes: repo, read:org, read:user"
